crossCheck: All 152 R/v/statistical-error entries match between original Table1 and Jiao TableA.1, exact published decimal precision.

Eilers2019.method: Circular velocity inferred by axisymmetric Jeans modelling of APOGEE/WISE/2MASS/Gaia DR2 red giants, not raw stellar azimuthal speeds.

Jiao2021.method: Reproduces Eilers points and adds a fractional systematic prescription; this is the SAME dataset, not an independent second sample.
Jiao2021.globalScaleUncertainty: Approximately 2 percent common velocity scale discussed separately in section2.1; covariance matrix not supplied.

redistribution: CSV contains numerical scientific facts transcribed from cited tables. Original article PDFs retained locally for verification; release links to official/arXiv sources rather than redistributing complete publisher works.
scope: 5.27 to24.82 kpc. No covariance supplied. Statistical asymmetry retained; no synthetic points or flat observational line.
